## Pointer: the vacuous-vote follow-up now sits under the Janitor Cleanup epic

Per operator decision, `clubbable-teriyaki-oriole` (b973-b298-9b5d-4765) has been reparented under
epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86, because the original scanner ticket `jaunty-pugnacious-stinkpot` is
still open and that session owns the scanner work.

This ticket is NOT being dispatched by the orphan-bug orchestrator. Recording two things a future
reader needs:

**Its ACs are stale.** All five describe the `set -eu` pipefail one-liner from change 2612, which
was landed and then REVERTED. Current main is post-revert: the workflow, the installer script, the
locks and the Makefile target are all absent. Several of the 16 recorded file_impact paths no
longer exist.

**The revert's premise was corrected by a read-only diagnosis** (comment #10 on this ticket):
pytest NEVER RAN. Execution died in the install step's post-install version verification
(Makefile:503) because `_link_semgrep` creates a RELATIVE symlink that breaks under a relative
`--prefix`. So the nine SCANNER_INTEGRATION_NODES contracts are UNTESTED, not failing — a
materially different starting point for any re-land.

**Any re-land must follow ADR 0114**: advisory/non-voting first, one independent passing run on
`main`, and only then promotion into the required Verified aggregate. That ADR exists because of
this incident.
